title: codonopsis javanica subsp. japonica
intro: Codonopsis javanica subsp. japonica, commonly known as Dong quai root or Japanese codonopsis, is a type of flowering plant native to East Asia, often used as a medicinal herb. The health benefits of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various diseases, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Codonopsis javanica subsp. japonica include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and act as a tonic to promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and other bioactive compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
